title: Cancellation, Credits and Refunds for Dental and Vision Savings Memberships
content:
# Cancellation, Credits and Refunds

**Cancellation and credit rules.** For the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships, cancelling is the member's own decision and can be made at any time. After the money-back period a cancellation ends the membership at the end of the period already paid; a monthly member receives no partial refund, and an annual member is credited the annual fee multiplied by the number of unused full months and divided by twelve, rounded half up to the cent (credit reason: unused months). A fee charged twice for the same period is credited in full (credit reason: duplicate charge). Credits are refunded to the card within the refund processing period of 10 business days.

## Status of the membership on cancellation

- A member may cancel before activation; the membership moves from pending activation to cancelled.
- A member may cancel an active membership; it ends at the end of the paid period, or immediately with a full refund within the money-back period. The membership's recorded last day is the last day of the membership.

## Outcomes after the money-back period

| Billing | When the membership ends | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly | End of the month already paid | None — no partial refund |
| Annual | End of the term already paid | Annual fee multiplied by the unused full months, divided by twelve, rounded half up to the cent |

Separately from cancellation, a fee charged twice for the same period is credited in full, and every credit is refunded to the card within 10 business days.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

An annual member with a hypothetical annual fee of 130.00 cancels after the money-back period with 7 unused full months. 130.00 multiplied by 7 is 910.00; divided by twelve it is 75.8333; rounded half up to the cent, the credit is 75.83. The membership ends at the end of the paid term, and the 75.83 is refunded to the card within 10 business days.

A monthly member cancelling after the money-back period, partway through a paid month, receives no credit for that month; the membership ends at the end of it.
